nodes.title: Forward-transition entry setting [r = throttle_in / learnt hover throttle, pre-climb hold s]
nodes.text: Entry procedure (closure round 2026-11-14): hover in QSTABILIZE; set throttle_in = r x the learnt Q_M_THST_HOVER (transmitter throttle override on the transition switch, not a stick position); hold it for the pre-climb time (the aircraft climbs at (r dl - dl) g); then select FBWA. ArduPilot holds MAX(hover, throttle_in) from the mode change to Q_TAILSIT_ANGLE (SRC-B3-AP-TAILSIT, SRC-B3-AP-ATCMULTI), with Q_A_ANGLE_BOOST 0. Static thrust / W at entry = dl_true x r
nodes.basis: team/B3/closure1114.py (results/closure1114.json design): window on static T0/W at 12 deg/s, 70 deg, forward CG: low end 1.2827 at a 4 m/s pre-climb (use 0.60, gust 1.0, handover 12.94 m/s; 1.3278 from a steady hover), high end 0.80 x 1.7456 = 1.3968 (A2.md §2.3). r = 1.285 centres the realisation band of ASM-B3-TRANS-REALISE in it (edges 1.2908 / 1.3893). Hold 2.0 s gives >= 4.17 m/s at the low edge. Replaces D-149's '>= 1.4 W' (frac 0.802 > 0.80). The firmware law is read from source, so SITL S4c confirms it and is no longer a condition. FINAL RE-RUN 2026-11-14: hold 2.0 -> 1.0 s. With the X2814 + 11x8E the thrust lapse with speed is smaller, the climb to 17 m/s at the high edge read 66.2 m (50 m start + 66.2 > the 110 m fence); 1.0 s reads 50.6 m, the low edge still credits 2.1 m/s and needs none (use 0.319 without it)

nodes.title: Hover yaw with the belly into the wind (D-152): aerodynamic yaw stiffness and the weathervane dead band
nodes.equation: heading error psi from belly-into-wind ; wing broadside (restoring): M_w = q S CN90 cos psi e_w, e_w = 0.75 sin psi / (4 + pi cos psi) b (Kirchhoff CP shift toward the upwind tip, the form of M_fin in CALC-B3-HOVER-WTIP) ; upwind half-fins (destabilising, CP upwind of the CG): F_f = 2 kq q a_f psi fc fh, a_f = 2 pi A / (2 + sqrt(A^2 + 4)), A = fc / fh (Helmbold, EST), kq = (u/U)^2 at the fin quarter chord in front of a plate normal to the flow, u/U = x / sqrt(x^2 + (c/2)^2), x = 0.75 fh, and kq = 1 as a bound ; arm = 0.75 fh + z_cg ; downwind half-fins in the wake: 0 (their moment is restoring, so leaving them out is conservative) ; props: H-forces cancel in y/z-symmetric pairs ; M_net = M_w - M_f (restoring +) ; weathervane: roll lean phi = atan(F_f / W) ; dead band psi_db where phi = ANG_MIN ; with a roll trim error d the band reaches (ANG_MIN + d) on one side ; M_ctrl = 4 dT (kq_iso f_low + r sin cant)

nodes.title: Belly into a 5 m/s wind, 30 deg heading error: aerodynamic yaw moment toward belly-into-wind (wing broadside restoring less the upwind half-fins, fin q not reduced)
nodes.how: Twin hover logs (C5 M2): heading error and yaw RCOU at touchdown with the belly to the wind; hanging yaw test in a measured 5 m/s wind (free to yaw, motors off): the aircraft settles belly to the wind.
nodes.note: D-152 condition 'B3 confirms weathervane stability'. EST model: Kirchhoff CP shift on a plate of aspect ratio 0.28 and a low-AR fin slope; > 0 means the heading is statically stable about belly-into-wind without any yaw control

nodes.title: CG balance at the limits
nodes.procedure: H1: balance the ready-to-fly aircraft on two fingertips (or a knife-edge jig) at the fin roots; the balance line must lie between the two marks drawn at the B3 limits.

nodes.title: Twin neutral point from glides
nodes.procedure: Twin, FBWA glides at 3 speeds for 2 pack positions; plot elevon trim vs CL; Xnp where the slope is 0.

nodes.title: Twin FW yaw doublet
nodes.procedure: Twin in FBWA at 1.3 Vs, 50 m AGL, CG on the aft mark: yaw pulse by differential thrust; heading and sideslip return within 2 s, yaw-rate oscillation decays.

nodes.title: Twin (TW3): QHOVER at 5 m/s measured wind with a wingtip into the wind, yaw steps of +/-10 and +/-20 deg
nodes.procedure: Hold heading with a wingtip into wind (Q_WVANE off for the test, heading by stick), step the heading +/-10 then +/-20 deg and release. Pass: heading returns, yaw RCOU spread (diagonal pairs) <= 30 % of hover output. Confirmation (closure round): the claim passes at the cross-flow Cd upper bound (CL-B3-HOVER-YAW-WTIP-20-CDMAX); a reading above 1.023 x model would mean the model form is wrong (not the Cd), and B3 re-opens the claim with the measured moment; the 10 deg spares exist for that.

nodes.title: Hover authority in wind
nodes.procedure: Tethered then free hover at 5 m/s measured wind; no motor output above 85 % or below 10 % (RCOU).
